description: This PHP class defines the data processing logic for generating an Employee Leave Entitlement Usage Report within the OrangeHRM system. It implements report data normalization and metadata retrieval, utilizing various service traits and external dependencies to gather and format leave entitlement data for employees.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData
classes.description: A class responsible for preparing and providing leave entitlement usage report data for employees, including normalization of leave data and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Generates a normalized array of leave entitlement data for reporting, including leave type details, balances, and URLs for detailed views.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report, such as total leave types count and employee information.
